test_title: PYST 50: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 01 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

KBT : PEU :: UQA : ZTB :: FJR : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Decreasing odd number series is subtracted from the position values of 1st, 2nd and 3rd letter respectively according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• KBT : PEU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8028d59ff321a1ed3a3993f902f322b6d67d76d24c7352799cb83c78d0c7695.png] 

And,

 
• UQA : ZTB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b1ed9450b41e0faf9ca718563ad09f2e5689fe1febe950ad967c67e97602478.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• FJR : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/880c2dd4b07808a1a5aef4cf4129d222dcd3f988b763903847fcc57bcfef0547.png] 

​Hence, "**KMS**" is the correct answer.

4c
